forms.name: list
forms.description: Enumerate authorized retained operations with exact optional resource filtering and complete bounded continuation. Active selection preserves unresolved effects and holds even for terminal operations; retained history gaps are explicit. Discover non-effectful prepared capsules through workflow.list.

forms.name: show
forms.description: Inspect the outcome of the exact original request; absence of a reply does not prove absence of work.

forms.name: apply
forms.description: Submit the exact reviewed plan and digest using the current owner authority generation and original request identity; acknowledgement means accepted responsibility, not completed execution.

forms.name: plan-stdin
forms.description: Prepare a reviewable plan from the exact supplied action and resource, including affected scope, disruption, data consequences and recovery limits.

forms.name: app-check
forms.description: Observe the selected application; checking does not silently repair it or adopt new source.

forms.name: app-restart
forms.description: Plan a restart of the selected application under its already accepted release.

forms.name: app-repair
forms.description: Plan restoration of accepted application configuration without silently upgrading or replacing data.

forms.name: app-backup
forms.description: Plan a recovery capture; capture success and restore-drill evidence remain distinct.

forms.name: cancel
forms.description: Request cancellation of the exact operation. Confirmed effects remain and unknown effects must be reconciled; cancellation does not promise rollback or release holds.

forms.name: show-epoch
forms.description: Resolve the original request against the exact owner authority generation.

forms.name: workflow-show
forms.description: Inspect the exact retained owner capsule, including preparation before child operations exist.

forms.name: workflow-prepare
forms.description: Read a complete workflow PrepareRequest from stdin, stage its canonical bytes as workflow-input through content.begin/chunk/commit, and submit the bounded InputReference. Retain its typed immutable proposal and locally owned content before acknowledging the non-effectful capsule. Preparation is not acceptance of child effects; stdin or frame bounds cannot silently cut its complete closure.

forms.name: workflow-advance
forms.description: Read a complete AdvanceRequest from stdin and submit it through staged workflow-input custody using the bounded InputReference. New advances compare the exact local generation and driver term. Transfer completion requires every participant's verified transferred witness and atomically retains the completion evidence, procedure phase and immutable advance receipt. Exact accepted advance IDs replay before new-admission expiry or generation checks.

forms.name: workflow-transfer
forms.description: Read a complete WorkflowTransferRequest from stdin and submit it through staged workflow-input custody using the bounded InputReference. Preserve every participant and prerequisite witness, regardless of frame size. New phases compare the current local generation; an identical accepted phase replays its discoverable original generation, proposal and witnesses. The new driver completes the transfer through workflow.advance with the complete commit closure. Timeout never releases custody.

forms.name: record-read
forms.description: Read one bounded chunk using the exact RecordReference, offset and length from closed stdin input. Reauthorize the actual receiving principal and protected snapshot scope; no reference is bearer authority.

forms.name: logs
forms.description: Read a bounded log page using exact owner epoch, resource, nullable opaque cursor and limit from closed stdin input. Every page, including an empty page, retains owner/resource identity and explicit continuation.

authorization: actual receiving principal, same protected owner use cases
